additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417678-DC/Si-D/FR-[ Y2 / R2 312555359053 ] lost communication from the OCPP CRM:02684000056
additional_info.body:
Dear RC France servicesdigitaux.fr,
Greetings of the Day!
The OCPP router's mobile connection was temporarily disconnected, causing a disruption in the OCPP connection. After a brief period, the mobile connection to the router was restored, and the OCPP connection reestablished. Currently, the charger is online and connected to the OCPP.
Additionally, we noticed that the charger is currently running on old firmware. We recommend upgrading your charger’s firmware. Please let us know if you'd like to update the firmware, or if we can proceed with closing the ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
